answer: The jury's own reward depends on rejecting low-quality answers, creating a shared incentive among honest graders to spot coordinated fakery, so a Sybil cluster collapses under the weight of its own low scores. This is why the network can stay open without a central gatekeeper: the economics of reputation do the filtering that a trusted authority otherwise would.. The defense holds because trust accrues slowly and is lost fast, so a farm that ever submits a copied answer destroys the value of that identity. Consider a whisper as the anchor of the cost.
